summary: Frontend-only Expo/React Native VALEO app — 4 NEW features validated end-to-end on mobile web preview (390x844). All 26 test assertions PASSED plus 5 regression checks (loan approve/refuse, add planteur, FAB pesée). FEATURE 1 (coop-recap PDF): row present & tappable, shows notice modal on web (native-only PDF share) — no crash. FEATURE 2 (coop-export & coop-restore): both rows present, tappable; both trigger notice-ok modal on web and dismiss correctly. FEATURE 3 (Planteur filters): two horizontal chip rows render — 'Tous villages / Bécédi / Gomon / Sikensi' and 'Toutes cultures / 🍫 Cacao / ...'. Tapping filter-Gomon narrows list from 5→2 planteurs (Amoin Adjoua + Konan Kouadio). filter-🍫 Cacao works. Search field works alongside filters (Amoin narrows to 1). FEATURE 4 (Signature bordereau): opened MemberDetail → Bordereau; testID 'sig-add' visible with 'Partager PDF' & 'Imprimer' also present. Tapping sig-add reveals SignaturePad (sig-clear appears) + 'Enregistrer' + 'Annuler' buttons; Annuler returns to sig-add state. No red screens, no console errors (only one non-blocking RN Web warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated).

issues: Non-blocking RN Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (triggered on Signature pad empty overlay, Signature.tsx:69). Also previous 'shadow*' style-prop deprecation still present.

action_items: Optional: migrate `pointerEvents='none'` on the Signature empty-hint View (Signature.tsx line 69) to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none', ... }}` to silence RN Web warning.

PDF share, native file picker (backup restore), and touch-drawing of the signature pad are native-only and not exercisable on web preview — validate 'Partager PDF', 'Imprimer', Sauvegarde/Restauration, and actual pen-strokes on the APK/EAS build.
critical_code_review_comments: Bordereau signature flow is well-structured: sig-add ↔ pad (sig-clear/sig-redo) ↔ SaveBtn/Annuler with local `draft` state; onSign persists via store.setCollectionSignature. Clean.
Members screen filters use two independent horizontal ScrollViews with FilterChip testIDs derived from label (`filter-<label>`) — matches spec exactly (e.g., 'filter-Gomon', 'filter-🍫 Cacao').
index.tsx doRecap/doExport/doRestore correctly wrap async errors and surface a notice modal — good graceful fallback for web.

All testIDs from spec verified present: nav-coop, nav-planteurs, coop-recap, coop-export, coop-restore, notice-ok, filter-<label>, member-<id>, row-receipt, sig-add, sig-clear, sig-redo, bordereau-close, fab, save-btn, loan-approve-<id>, loan-refuse-<id>, coop-loans, add-member.
seed_data_creation: None — used preloaded demo seed (patron M. Diomandé + 5 planteurs across Bécédi/Gomon/Sikensi).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://app-deploy-187.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport 390x844. Two select-trigger on Login: index 0=coop (choose 'M. Diomandé' for patron), then click first 'Se connecter'. To reach new-feature rows: nav-coop → scroll to 'Données & rapports' section (coop-recap/coop-export/coop-restore). Filters: nav-planteurs shows two chip rows; testIDs are literally 'filter-Gomon', 'filter-🍫 Cacao' (include emoji). Bordereau: open member → tap 'Bordereau' ghost button on any collection row (or row-receipt icon from dashboard). Signature drawing via mouse doesn't produce strokes on web (PanResponder locationX not fired) — just verify UI state transitions. Notice modal is dismissed via [data-testid='notice-ok'].
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 4 new features working as specified; regression flows still healthy.
